questions.q: In Family Living, the set of values, rules, and expected levels of behavior that a family adopts to guide its members is referred to as:
questions.explain: Family standards act as behavioral and qualitative benchmarks (like maintaining honesty, insisting on clean living spaces, or striving for high academic grades) that measure how family goals are achieved.
